not_run.reason: requires an explicit ownership inventory of Job handles, pidfds, inherited descriptors and monitor references on a disposable native scope; no Windows Job-object route is authorized and WSL2 has no equivalent handle lifecycle to observe.
requires approved abrupt physical/VM reset apparatus, separately powered witnesses, exact storage/cache topology and a recoverable test image; human-gated and not available.
requires a private writable Linux memory controller (memory.max) and explicit OOM group policy; cgroup v2 is mounted read-only in this WSL2 dev/test target and provoking global OOM is a safety stop.
WSL2 cannot be reliably suspended/resumed, host suspend is human-gated and outside the disposable target, and the Owner's elapsed-versus-active deadline-semantics choice is not recorded.
SMB/NFS are out of canonical scope (platform-floors D-028) and an isolated share/export with independent client and server witnesses is not available.
requires an observation-transport harness that can drop, duplicate and reorder synthetic notifications while independent native queries remain available.
requires separate MSYS2, Git Bash and embedded-terminal profile instances; only the WSL2 dev/test target exists in this environment.
requires disposable policy variants with exact security/configuration digests and explicit authorization for each local privilege or policy change; no test may disable production protections.
requires a stable writable cgroup scope with native cumulative counter baselines; cgroup v2 is mounted read-only in this WSL2 target.
the combined variant list must be preregistered and all component fixtures need independent evidence first; component coverage is incomplete.

static_findings.finding: All ten WSL run rows record fault_triggered=false. Scripts emit trace_end=1, but flag() accepts only lowercased true. _pack uses that flag, so this telemetry field is mechanically false even for recorded triggered hazards. The raw observations must be assessed independently; do not infer no actual fault from this bug.

check_traces.py requires pass rows to have observation/recovery ok=true and nonempty evidence, but never validates fault_triggered, negative_control.ok, actual matching fault/cut, digest-bound source/target identity, causal completeness or independent oracle quality. Artifact shape gate is not full trace conformance.

check_fu04.py explicitly requires original proposed_unexecuted/pending_owner/null-key manifest and unexecuted original catalog, then checks safe-probe count and file presence. This preserves historical proposal scope; it does not overrule D-028 or certify receipt truth despite no-fabricated-result wording.

Runner merges prior target results by (id,target), while top-level invocation records only latest invocation. Current file says host/allow_destructive=false yet contains WSL destructive observations by design. Per-row immutable run IDs, timestamps, source/config/target hashes are needed for an accepted merged corpus. This is a provenance gap, not evidence of unauthorized execution.

platform-floors.json key also_qualified means intended additional Enterprise qualification case in context, not completed evidence. The file says qualification none and maps native_windows in_scope_unqualified.

Kickoff probes.json destructive_not_run has older PF ID/title assignments that differ from the normalized catalog (for example PF08 disk-full versus current PF08 lock lifetime). Do not merge by PF ID without catalog identity and title crosswalk.
